Prerequisites for Virtualization and Passthrough

First verify CPU virtualization, firmware IOMMU, and kernel support. The monolithic libvirtd example below is one management model; current libvirt also offers modular daemons. Choose according to your installation, and do not mix service startup approaches.

GPU passthrough requires a separate, suitable IOMMU group, while the host must retain working display and input devices. IOMMU logs alone do not prove that device grouping is safe for passthrough. After changing vfio bindings, check driver bindings with lspci -nnk; rebuild the initramfs when reverting as well. Do not blindly assign the host's only active GPU/USB controller to a guest.

Waydroid requires a Wayland session, kernel Binder support, and a working graphics path. ARM translation and additional image scripts are third-party components. Review their code and licenses before execution, especially installation flows using sudo. Android applications in a container do not automatically gain full compatibility with games, DRM, or anti-cheat systems.

Gaming on Linux

This section applies to Windows applications as well as Windows games. Prefer Steam for games, and manage games unavailable on Steam with Lutris, using Proton or Wine to run them. Use Waydroid for Android mobile games. If none of these works, play in a win11 virtual machine configured with GPU passthrough.

Running Applications with the Wine/Proton Compatibility Layer

Wine is a compatibility layer for running Windows programs on Linux. Proton is a gaming-focused compatibility layer developed from Wine by Valve, the company behind Steam. It works by translating requests made by Windows programs into equivalent requests on Linux. Usually, the latest Wine or Proton version is sufficient.

Download Lutris Lutris is a tool designed specifically for gaming, making it easy to manage software that needs the Wine or Proton compatibility layer. Lutris can manage standalone games and runners; its integration features differ from Steam's non-Steam game entries.

Gaming with GPU Passthrough

GPU passthrough gives the guest direct use of a dedicated GPU, but compatibility still depends on drivers, reset behavior, IOMMU, anti-cheat, and licensing requirements. Do not assume every game will run; retain working display and input devices for the host during testing.
